text:
Samira: Heads-up: a few managers just reported unexpected client travel and asked for signoff help. We have T-minus 18h on the review window. Can we agree an emergency protocol? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
PeopleOpsBot: Current snapshot: 11 managers pending signoff, 5 managers flagged OOO/travel. Export: pending_signoffs_2015.csv
Noah: I can batch 4 signoffs tomorrow AM. What's our threshold to extend vs delegate?
Ivy: Proposed rule: if >6 managers explicitly request delegation -> extend by 48h. If <=6, we try delegate/backup assignment. Keeps calibration schedule stable.
Tom: +1. Also we should define how delegation appears in the export so calibration leads don't double-count. Suggested fields: delegated=true, delegated_by, delegate_reason (travel/hiring/emergency), delegation_confirmed_ts.
Samira: Good. Also need a short delegate onboarding snippet we can paste into the form/comment. Draft: "You have been assigned as delegated reviewer for <manager>. Confirm in the review form under Reviewer assignments, add 1-2 context bullets, prefix calibration notes with 'DELEGATED:' and submit."
Noah: Can we put a tiny checkbox in the form that says "I accept delegated review" so it's explicit? If not, we can require a short comment.
Ivy: Form change will take time. For this cycle let's require the delegate to paste the acceptance line in the form comment: "I accept delegated review for <employee> (dates)". People Ops will reconcile.
Samira: Agreed. Also add a CSV column delegate_acceptance to the export for easy filtering.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled in 60 minutes to ping managers with outstanding signoffs.
Tom: One more wrinkle: several delegates are also interviewers this week. If we assign someone who later becomes unavailable, what's the fallback? Suggest order: original manager -> delegated reviewer -> People Ops assigned backup -> director-approved fallback. Everyone must be in the export.
Samira: I'll add that flow to the playbook and include a tiny diagram. For speed, can we use this template for manager messages? Copyable text below:

"Manager message template (paste in form comment):
I will be OOO <dates> and delegate signoff to <delegate name>. Delegate acceptance: <paste acceptance line>. If no acceptance, please assign People Ops backup.
"

Ivy: Love it. Also propose we flag any delegated review where the delegate updates the rating vs the manager draft. Those rows should get a "needs-manager-confirmation" flag in the export so calibration leads can surface them.
Noah: Good point. Add column rating_diff=true/false and rating_diff_note.
Samira: Operational steps I'm taking now: 1) send manager ping asking for out:dates/delegate, 2) start assigning backups after 2h grace, 3) update export with delegation fields, 4) publish final plan here. Will also draft a 4-line delegate checklist to paste in thread.
PeopleOpsBot: Manager ping sent. Link: /pings/signoff-window-2015. Reminder: if >6 delegate requests, People Ops will propose 48h extension.
Tom: Quick delegate checklist please (short).
Samira: Posted: "Delegate checklist:
- Confirm acceptance in form comment
- Read manager bullets (3 examples)
- Add DELEGATED: prefix in calibration note
- Flag rating mismatches with brief rationale
"
Noah: I'm taking 3 signoffs now. Will update when done. :thumbsup:
Ivy: I'll monitor export and add delegation columns. If we hit 7 delegate requests, I'll post extension notice and update PeopleOpsBot schedule.
Samira: Thanks team. If we extend, I'll also email calibration leads and post revised packet publish time. T-minus 2h for the manager response window, after that we'll start manual backups. Closing loop for now.
